svg.aria-label: Geometric card cutout area model and degree cancellation
svg.title: Geometric card cutout area model and degree cancellation
svg.desc: Four staged panels: rectangular card dimensions (x+4) by (x+2), inner cutout of side x, quadratic term cancellation x^2 - x^2 = 0, and numerical check at x=2.

g.text: 1 · Rectangular card with interior square cutout
Outer card area: A_outer(x) = (x + 4)(x + 2) = x² + 6x + 8 cm² (degree 2)
Inner cutout area: A_inner(x) = x² cm² (degree 2)
Degree drops from 2 to 1 because leading quadratic coefficients cancel to zero.
4 · Check at admissible value x = 2: 24 - 4 = 20 cm² == 6(2) + 8 = 20 cm²
